articles.summary: Coda Octopus Engineering and our sister organization Coda Octopus are proud to be attending the Navy League's Sea-Air-Space Expo. This event is a great opportunity to learn about our work developing SONAR hardware and software, and telemetry systems engineering. Learn more about the powerful Thermite® line of rugged embedded computers…
articles.title: Visit Coda Octopus Engineering and Coda Octopus at Sea-Air-Space 2022
